madness.description: Madness cards come from the shared Madness deck and are never part of your starting deck. At game end, every 2 Madness cards you still keep cost you 1 VP.

duel.title: Duel
duel.description: A duel makes two minions compare their power in a separate showdown and resolve through the duel flow. Only cards that explicitly say they start a duel enter this extra resolution.

powerCounters.title: +1 Power Counters
powerCounters.description: Each +1 power counter on a minion grants it 1 extra power. Many cards in these factions keep chaining by placing, moving, or removing those counters.

cowboysDuel.title: Cowboys: Duel Tutorial
cowboysDuel.description: Walk through a fixed duel sequence featuring Pinkerton, duel-card timing, and Deputy resolution.

steps.setup: Preparing the Cowboys duel tutorial scenario…
steps.duelIntro: This tutorial focuses only on the Cowboys duel mechanic. You will see the challenge, Pinkerton counter timing, duel-card windows, and Deputy boost before the duel resolves.
steps.playGunfighter: Play Gunfighter first, then target the enemy Microbot in the Saloon to start the duel.
steps.pecosBillWindow: When the duel starts, the Cowboys titan Pecos Bill asks whether you want to discard a card and join this duel. Skip it here so the tutorial can stay focused on the core duel flow.
steps.pinkertonCounter: Pinkerton triggers before duel cards resolve. Place 1 +1 power counter on your dueling minion.
steps.duelCard: Now your duel-card window opens. Skip it in this tutorial so we can focus on the core Cowboys duel flow.
steps.opponentDuelCard: The opponent has no extra response here, so the tutorial will automatically pass their duel-card window.
steps.deputyBoost: Discard Deputy now to give Gunfighter +2 power until end of turn and secure the duel win.
steps.finish: The duel has resolved: the enemy minion is gone, Deputy is in your discard pile, and there is no active duel left. You have completed the core Cowboys duel flow.

steps.aiPlayMinion:
Look! Our "Star-Spawn of Cthulhu" has appeared on the base.

This power-5 minion has a Talent ability — you'll get to activate it shortly.
steps.welcome:
Welcome to Smash Up!

In this game, you pick two factions and shuffle their decks together, then compete to score bases and earn Victory Points.

First to 15 VP wins!
steps.scoreboard:
This is the scoreboard, showing each player's Victory Points (VP) and chosen factions.

Your goal is to reach 15 VP first!
steps.handIntro:
This is your hand area. Your deck is a mix of cards from your two factions.

Cards come in two types:
• Minions — placed on bases to contribute power
• Actions — trigger special effects
steps.turnTracker:
This shows the current turn number and game phase.

Each turn follows: Play Cards → Score Bases → Draw.
steps.endTurnBtn: This is the End Phase button. After you're done with each phase, click it to move on.
steps.playCardsExplain:
It's the Play Cards phase!

Each turn you may play 1 minion and 1 action (one of each).

Minions go on bases to add power; actions trigger special effects.
steps.playMinion:
Try playing a minion!

Click the "Librarian" in your hand to select it, then choose a base to place it on.

This power-4 minion has a Talent ability — once it's on the base, you can activate it!
steps.playAction:
Nice! Now play an action card.

The "Howl" action gives all your minions +1 power. Click the action card in your hand to select it, then click it again to use it.
steps.useTalent:
Notice the glowing golden "Librarian" on the base!

Some minions have Talent abilities that can be activated once per turn.

Click the glowing "Librarian" to use its Talent — discard a Madness card and draw a card!
steps.endPlayCards: Done playing cards! Click the End Phase button to proceed.
steps.baseScoring:
Base Scoring: when the total power of all minions on a base reaches or exceeds its breakpoint, that base scores.

After scoring, minions on the base are discarded and a new base is revealed.
steps.vpAwards:
When a base scores, the top 3 players by power receive the VP rewards shown on the base card.

The player with the most power gets the biggest reward!
steps.drawExplain: Draw phase: at the end of each turn you draw 2 cards to refill your hand.
steps.handLimit:
Note the hand limit is 10 cards.

If you exceed the limit after drawing, you must discard down to 10.
steps.endDraw: Draw phase complete! When your hand is at or under 10 cards, the phase advances automatically.
steps.opponentTurn: It's your opponent's turn now. Watch what they do...
steps.talentIntro:
Some minions have Talent abilities that can be used once per turn.

Look for the Talent marker on minion cards! Talents reset at the start of your turn.
steps.turnCycle:
Turns alternate between players, each following Play Cards → Score → Draw.

Use your plays wisely to build power advantages on key bases!
steps.summary:
Tutorial complete! Key takeaways:

• Pick 2 factions and shuffle them together
• Each turn: play 1 minion + 1 action
• Bases score when total power hits the breakpoint
• First to 15 VP wins
steps.finish: You've learned the basics of Smash Up. Ready to smash?

dino_rampage.name: Rampage
dino_rampage.effectText: Reduce a base's breakpoint by the total power of your minions there until the end of the turn.

dino_survival_of_the_fittest.name: Survival of the Fittest
dino_survival_of_the_fittest.effectText: On each base with two or more minions where one has higher power, destroy the minion with the lowest power (you choose in case of a tie).

elder_thing_elder_thing.name: Elder Thing
elder_thing_elder_thing.abilityText: Destroy two of your other minions or place this minion on the bottom of your deck. Ongoing: This minion is not affected by other players' cards.

elder_thing_shoggoth.name: Shoggoth
elder_thing_shoggoth.abilityText: You may only play this card on a base where you have at least 6 power. Each other player may draw a Madness card. Destroy a minion on this base belonging to each player who did not.

elder_thing_mi_go.name: Mi-go
elder_thing_mi_go.abilityText: Each other player may draw a Madness card. For each player that does not, draw a card.

elder_thing_byakhee.name: Byakhee
elder_thing_byakhee.abilityText: Each other player with a minion here draws a Madness card.

elder_thing_power_of_madness.name: Power of Madness
elder_thing_power_of_madness.effectText: Each other player reveals their hand, discards all Madness cards in it, and shuffles their discard pile into their deck.

elder_thing_insanity.name: Insanity
elder_thing_insanity.effectText: Each other player draws two Madness cards.

elder_thing_dunwich_horror.name: Dunwich Horror
elder_thing_dunwich_horror.effectText: Play on a minion. This minion has +5 power. Destroy this minion at the end of the turn.

elder_thing_begin_the_summoning.name: Begin the Summoning
elder_thing_begin_the_summoning.effectText: Place a minion from your discard pile on top of your deck. You may play an extra action this turn.

elder_thing_spreading_horror.name: Spreading Horror
elder_thing_spreading_horror.effectText: Each other player discards cards at random until they discard a card that is not a Madness card.

elder_thing_the_price_of_power.name: The Price of Power
elder_thing_the_price_of_power.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, each other player with a minion here reveals their hand. For each Madness card revealed, one of your minions here gains +2 power until the end of the turn.

elder_thing_unfathomable_goals.name: Unfathomable Goals
elder_thing_unfathomable_goals.effectText: Each other player reveals their hand. Each player who reveals a Madness card must destroy one of their minions.

elder_thing_touch_of_madness.name: Touch of Madness
elder_thing_touch_of_madness.effectText: Each other player draws a Madness card. Draw a card and play an extra action this turn.

ghost_spectre.name: Spectre
ghost_spectre.abilityText: Ability: If you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, any time you could play a minion, you may play this card from your discard pile instead.

ghost_haunting.name: Haunting
ghost_haunting.abilityText: Ongoing: If you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, this minion has +3 power and cannot be affected by other players' cards.

ghost_spirit.name: Spirit
ghost_spirit.abilityText: Choose a minion. You may discard a number of cards equal to that minion's power to destroy it.

ghost_ghost.name: Ghost
ghost_ghost.abilityText: You may discard a card from your hand.

ghost_seance.name: Séance
ghost_seance.effectText: If you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, draw until you have 5 cards.

ghost_incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
ghost_incorporeal.effectText: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: This minion cannot be affected by other players' cards.

ghost_ghostly_arrival.name: Ghostly Arrival
ghost_ghostly_arrival.effectText: You may play an extra minion and/or an extra action.

ghost_make_contact.name: Make Contact
ghost_make_contact.effectText: You may only play this card if it is the only card in your hand. Play on a minion. Ongoing: As long as this card and that minion are in play, you control that minion.

ghost_shady_deal.name: Shady Deal
ghost_shady_deal.effectText: If you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, gain 1 VP.

ghost_door_to_the_beyond.name: Door to the Beyond
ghost_door_to_the_beyond.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: If you have 2 or fewer cards in hand, each of your minions here has +2 power.

ghost_the_dead_rise.name: The Dead Rise
ghost_the_dead_rise.effectText: Discard any number of cards. Play an extra minion from your discard pile with less power than the number of cards you discarded.

ghost_across_the_divide.name: Across the Divide
ghost_across_the_divide.effectText: Choose a card name. Take any number of minions with that name from your discard pile into your hand.

innsmouth_the_locals.name: The Locals
innsmouth_the_locals.abilityText: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Place any Locals revealed this way into your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck.

innsmouth_mysteries_of_the_deep.name: Mysteries of the Deep
innsmouth_mysteries_of_the_deep.effectText: If you have three or more minions with the same name on a base, draw 3 cards. You may then draw 2 extra cards and 2 Madness cards.

innsmouth_sacred_circle.name: Sacred Circle
innsmouth_sacred_circle.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: You may play an extra minion here that has the same name as a minion here.

innsmouth_return_to_the_sea.name: Return to the Sea
innsmouth_return_to_the_sea.effectText: Special: After a base scores, you may place any number of your minions with the same name there into your hand instead of the discard pile.

innsmouth_new_acolytes.name: New Acolytes
innsmouth_new_acolytes.effectText: All players shuffle all minions in their discard piles into their decks.

innsmouth_recruitment.name: Recruitment
innsmouth_recruitment.effectText: Draw up to 3 Madness cards. For each card drawn, play an extra minion this turn.

innsmouth_spreading_the_word.name: Spreading the Word
innsmouth_spreading_the_word.effectText: Play up to two extra minions with the same name as a minion in play.

innsmouth_in_plain_sight.name: In Plain Sight
innsmouth_in_plain_sight.effectText: Play on a base. Your minions of power 2 or less here are not affected by other players' cards.

innsmouth_the_deep_ones.name: The Deep Ones
innsmouth_the_deep_ones.effectText: Each of your minions of power 2 or less gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

killer_plant_venus_man_trap.name: Venus Man Trap
killer_plant_venus_man_trap.abilityText: Talent: Search your deck for a minion with power 2 or less and play it here as an extra minion. Shuffle your deck.

killer_plant_weed_eater.name: Weed Eater
killer_plant_weed_eater.abilityText: This minion has -2 power on the turn you play it.

killer_plant_water_lily.name: Water Lily
killer_plant_water_lily.abilityText: Ongoing: At the start of each of your turns, draw a card. You may only use one Water Lily's ability per turn.

killer_plant_sprout.name: Sprout
killer_plant_sprout.abilityText: Ongoing: At the start of your turn, destroy this card. You may search your deck for a minion with power 3 or less and play it here as an extra minion. Shuffle your deck.

killer_plant_budding.name: Budding
killer_plant_budding.effectText: Choose a minion in play. Search your deck for a card with the same name and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

killer_plant_deep_roots.name: Deep Roots
killer_plant_deep_roots.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions on this base cannot be moved or returned to your hand by other players' abilities.

killer_plant_choking_vines.name: Choking Vines
killer_plant_choking_vines.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, destroy this minion.

killer_plant_blossom.name: Blossom
killer_plant_blossom.effectText: Play up to three extra minions with the same name.

killer_plant_sleep_spores.name: Sleep Spores
killer_plant_sleep_spores.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Other players' minions on this base have -1 power. (min 0)

killer_plant_overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
killer_plant_overgrowth.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: At the start of your turn, reduce this base's breakpoint to 0.

killer_plant_entangled.name: Entangled
killer_plant_entangled.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Minions on any base where you have a minion cannot be moved or returned to hand. Destroy this card at the start of your turn.

special_madness.name: Madness
special_madness.effectText: Draw two cards OR consume this card.

miskatonic_professor.name: Professor
miskatonic_professor.abilityText: Talent: Discard a Madness card. If you do, you may play an extra action and/or an extra minion.

miskatonic_librarian.name: Librarian
miskatonic_librarian.abilityText: Talent: Discard a Madness card. If you do, draw a card.

miskatonic_psychologist.name: Psychologist
miskatonic_psychologist.abilityText: You may consume a Madness card from your hand or discard pile.

miskatonic_researcher.name: Researcher
miskatonic_researcher.abilityText: You may draw a Madness card.

miskatonic_book_of_iter_the_unseen.name: Jinkies!
miskatonic_book_of_iter_the_unseen.effectText: Look at any player's hand. Draw a Madness card and play two extra actions.

miskatonic_mandatory_reading.name: Things Best Not Known
miskatonic_mandatory_reading.effectText: Choose a player. That player draws two Madness cards. You may play an extra action.

miskatonic_lost_knowledge.name: Gate to Beyond
miskatonic_lost_knowledge.effectText: If you have two Madness cards in hand, reveal them to draw two cards and play an extra minion and an extra action this turn.

miskatonic_thing_on_the_doorstep.name: Old Man Jenkins!?
miskatonic_thing_on_the_doorstep.effectText: Search your deck for a minion or action and add it to your hand. Draw a Madness card. Shuffle your deck.

miskatonic_psychological_profiling.name: That's So Crazy...
miskatonic_psychological_profiling.effectText: Draw two cards and draw a Madness card.

miskatonic_it_might_just_work.name: It Just Might Work
miskatonic_it_might_just_work.effectText: Discard two Madness cards to destroy a minion.

miskatonic_those_meddling_kids.name: Those Meddling Kids
miskatonic_those_meddling_kids.effectText: Destroy any number of actions on a base.

miskatonic_field_trip.name: Field Trip
miskatonic_field_trip.effectText: Place any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck and draw a card for each card placed.

ninja_master.name: Ninja Master
ninja_master.abilityText: You may destroy a minion on this base.

ninja_tiger_assassin.name: Tiger Assassin
ninja_tiger_assassin.abilityText: You may destroy a minion of power 3 or less on this base.

ninja_shinobi.name: Shinobi
ninja_shinobi.abilityText: Special: Before a base scores, you may play this minion there. Special: You may use this ability of a Shinobi only once per base.

ninja_acolyte.name: Ninja Acolyte
ninja_acolyte.abilityText: Special: During your turn, if you have not played a minion, you may return this card to your hand to play an extra minion on this base.

ninja_way_of_deception.name: Way of Deception
ninja_way_of_deception.effectText: Move one of your minions to another base.

ninja_smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
ninja_smoke_bomb.effectText: Play on one of your minions. Ongoing: This minion is not affected by other players' actions. Destroy this card at the start of your turn.

ninja_assassination.name: Assassination
ninja_assassination.effectText: Play on a minion. Ongoing: Destroy that minion at the end of the turn.

ninja_hidden_ninja.name: Hidden Ninja
ninja_hidden_ninja.effectText: Special: Before a base scores, play a minion there.

ninja_seeing_stars.name: Seeing Stars
ninja_seeing_stars.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Your minions here are not affected by other players' actions.

ninja_disguise.name: Disguise
ninja_disguise.effectText: Choose one or two of your minions on a base. Play the same number of minions there, then place the chosen minions into your hand.

ninja_infiltrate.name: Infiltrate
ninja_infiltrate.effectText: Play on a base. Destroy an action that has been played here. Ongoing: You may ignore this base's ability until the start of your next turn.

ninja_poison.name: Poison
ninja_poison.effectText: Play on a minion. Destroy any number of actions on it. Ongoing: This minion has -4 power. (Minion power is reduced to a minimum of 0.)

pirate_king.name: Pirate King
pirate_king.abilityText: Special: Before a base scores, you may move this minion there.

pirate_buccaneer.name: Buccaneer
pirate_buccaneer.abilityText: Special: If this minion would be destroyed, move it to another base instead.

pirate_saucy_wench.name: Saucy Wench
pirate_saucy_wench.abilityText: You may destroy a minion of power 2 or less at this base.

pirate_first_mate.name: First Mate
pirate_first_mate.abilityText: Special: After this base scores, you may move up to two of your minions to other bases instead of the discard pile.

pirate_dinghy.name: Dinghy
pirate_dinghy.effectText: Move up to two of your minions to other bases.

pirate_powderkeg.name: Powderkeg
pirate_powderkeg.effectText: Destroy one of your minions to destroy all minions at the same base with power equal to or less than the minion you destroyed.

pirate_broadside.name: Broadside
pirate_broadside.effectText: Destroy all of one player\'s minions of power 2 or less at a base where you have a minion.

pirate_full_sail.name: Full Sail
pirate_full_sail.effectText: Move any number of your minions to other bases. Special: You may play this card before a base scores.

pirate_cannon.name: Cannon
pirate_cannon.effectText: Destroy up to two minions of power 2 or less.

pirate_shanghai.name: Shanghai
pirate_shanghai.effectText: Move another player's minion to another base.

pirate_sea_dogs.name: Sea Dogs
pirate_sea_dogs.effectText: Choose a faction. Move all of other players' minions of that faction from one base to another.

pirate_swashbuckling.name: Swashbuckling
pirate_swashbuckling.effectText: Each of your minions gains +1 power until the end of the turn.

robot_nukebot.name: Nukebot
robot_nukebot.abilityText: Ongoing: After this minion is destroyed, destroy all other players' minions on this base.

robot_warbot.name: Warbot
robot_warbot.abilityText: Ongoing: This minion cannot be destroyed.

robot_hoverbot.name: Hoverbot
robot_hoverbot.abilityText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is a minion, you may play it as an extra minion. Otherwise, put it back on top of your deck.

robot_zapbot.name: Zapbot
robot_zapbot.abilityText: You may play an extra minion of power 2 or less.

robot_microbot_reclaimer.name: Microbot Reclaimer
robot_microbot_reclaimer.abilityText: If this is the first minion you played this turn, you may play an extra minion. Shuffle any number of microbots from your discard pile into your deck.

robot_microbot_archive.name: Microbot Archive
robot_microbot_archive.abilityText: Ongoing: After one of your microbots is destroyed (including this one), draw a card.

robot_microbot_guard.name: Microbot Guard
robot_microbot_guard.abilityText: Destroy a minion here with power less than the number of minions you have here.

robot_microbot_alpha.name: Microbot Alpha
robot_microbot_alpha.abilityText: Ongoing: Gains +1 power for each of your other microbots in play. All of your minions are considered microbots.

robot_microbot_fixer.name: Microbot Fixer
robot_microbot_fixer.abilityText: If this is the first minion you played this turn, you may play an extra minion. Ongoing: Your microbots have +1 power.

robot_tech_center.name: Tech Center
robot_tech_center.effectText: Choose a base. Draw a card for each minion you have on that base.

steampunk_steam_queen.name: Steam Queen
steampunk_steam_queen.abilityText: Ongoing: Your actions cannot be affected by other players' cards.

steampunk_mechanic.name: Mechanic
steampunk_mechanic.abilityText: Choose an action in your discard pile that can be played on a base. Play it as an extra action.

steampunk_steam_man.name: Steam Man
steampunk_steam_man.abilityText: Ongoing: This minion has +1 power for each of your actions played on this base.

steampunk_captain_ahab.name: Captain Ahab
steampunk_captain_ahab.abilityText: Talent: Move this minion to a base where you have an action played on it.

steampunk_ornate_dome.name: Ornate Dome
steampunk_ornate_dome.effectText: Play on a base. Destroy all other players' actions played here. Ongoing: Other players cannot play actions on this base.

steampunk_aggromotive.name: Aggromotive
steampunk_aggromotive.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: If you have a minion here, you have +5 power here.

steampunk_scrap_diving.name: Scrap Diving
steampunk_scrap_diving.effectText: Take an action from your discard pile into your hand.

steampunk_zeppelin.name: Zeppelin
steampunk_zeppelin.effectText: Play on a base. Talent: Move one of your minions from another base to here, or from here to another base.

steampunk_change_of_venue.name: Change of Venue
steampunk_change_of_venue.effectText: Return one of your actions played on a base or minion to your hand. Play it as an extra action.

steampunk_rotary_slug_thrower.name: Rotary Slug Thrower
steampunk_rotary_slug_thrower.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Each of your minions here has +2 power.

steampunk_difference_engine.name: Difference Engine
steampunk_difference_engine.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: If you have a minion here, draw an extra card at the end of your turn.

steampunk_escape_hatch.name: Escape Hatch
steampunk_escape_hatch.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: When one of your minions here is destroyed, put it into your hand instead of the discard pile.

trickster_leprechaun.name: Leprechaun
trickster_leprechaun.abilityText: Ongoing: After another player plays a minion here with less power than this minion, destroy it (after its ability resolves).

trickster_brownie.name: Brownie
trickster_brownie.abilityText: Ongoing: If another player's card affects this minion, that player discards two cards at random.

trickster_gnome.name: Gnome
trickster_gnome.abilityText: You may destroy a minion here with power less than the number of minions you have here.

trickster_gremlin.name: Gremlin
trickster_gremlin.abilityText: Ongoing: After this minion is destroyed, draw a card and each other player discards a random card.

trickster_enshrouding_mist.name: Enshrouding Mist
trickster_enshrouding_mist.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: On your turn, you may play an extra minion on this base.

trickster_hideout.name: Hideout
trickster_hideout.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: If another player's action would affect your minions on this base, destroy this card to cancel that action.

trickster_mark_of_sleep.name: Mark of Sleep
trickster_mark_of_sleep.effectText: Choose a player. That player cannot play actions on their next turn.

trickster_flame_trap.name: Flame Trap
trickster_flame_trap.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: When another player plays a minion here, destroy that minion (after its ability resolves) and this card.

trickster_take_the_shinies.name: Take the Shinies
trickster_take_the_shinies.effectText: Each other player discards two random cards.

trickster_block_the_path.name: Block the Path
trickster_block_the_path.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Choose a faction. Minions of that faction cannot be played here.

trickster_disenchant.name: Disenchant
trickster_disenchant.effectText: Destroy an action played on a minion or a base.

trickster_pay_the_piper.name: Pay the Piper
trickster_pay_the_piper.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: After another player plays a minion here, that player discards a card.

wizard_archmage.name: Archmage
wizard_archmage.abilityText: Ongoing: You may play one extra action on each of your turns.

wizard_chronomage.name: Chronomage
wizard_chronomage.abilityText: You may play an extra action this turn.

wizard_neophyte.name: Neophyte
wizard_neophyte.abilityText: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it is an action, you may take it into your hand or play it as an extra action. Otherwise, put it back on top of your deck.

wizard_mass_enchantment.name: Mass Enchantment
wizard_mass_enchantment.effectText: Reveal the top card of each other player's deck. You may play one revealed action as an extra action. Put the remaining cards back on top of their owners' decks.

wizard_portal.name: Portal
wizard_portal.effectText: Reveal the top five cards of your deck. Take any of the revealed minions into your hand and put the remaining cards back on top of your deck in any order.

wizard_sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
wizard_sacrifice.effectText: Choose one of your minions. Draw cards equal to its power. Destroy that minion.

wizard_scry.name: Scry
wizard_scry.effectText: Search your deck for an action and reveal it to all players. Take it into your hand and shuffle your deck.

wizard_winds_of_change.name: Winds of Change
wizard_winds_of_change.effectText: Shuffle your hand into your deck and draw five cards. You may play an extra action.

zombie_lord.name: Zombie Lord
zombie_lord.abilityText: You may play one extra minion of power 2 or less from your discard pile on each base where you have no minions.

zombie_grave_digger.name: Grave Digger
zombie_grave_digger.abilityText: You may take a minion from your discard pile into your hand.

zombie_tenacious_z.name: Tenacious Z
zombie_tenacious_z.abilityText: Ability: On your turn, you may play this card from your discard pile as an extra minion. You may only use one Tenacious Z ability per turn.

zombie_walker.name: Walker
zombie_walker.abilityText: Look at the top card of your deck. You may discard it or put it back on top of your deck.

zombie_grave_robbing.name: Grave Robbing
zombie_grave_robbing.effectText: Take a card from your discard pile into your hand.

zombie_they_keep_coming.name: They Keep Coming
zombie_they_keep_coming.effectText: Play an extra minion from your discard pile.

zombie_lend_a_hand.name: Lend a Hand
zombie_lend_a_hand.effectText: Shuffle any number of cards from your discard pile into your deck.

zombie_overrun.name: Overrun
zombie_overrun.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: Other players cannot play minions on this base. At the start of your turn, destroy this card.

zombie_theyre_coming_to_get_you.name: They're Coming to Get You
zombie_theyre_coming_to_get_you.effectText: Play on a base. Ongoing: On your turn, you may play a minion from your discard pile on this base instead of from your hand.

zombie_not_enough_bullets.name: Not Enough Bullets
zombie_not_enough_bullets.effectText: Take any number of minions of the same name from your discard pile into your hand.

zombie_outbreak.name: Outbreak
zombie_outbreak.effectText: Play an extra minion on a base where you have no minions.

zombie_mall_crawl.name: Mall Crawl
zombie_mall_crawl.effectText: Search your deck for any number of cards of the same name and put them into your discard pile. Shuffle your deck.

changerbots_mergacon.name: Mergacon
changerbots_mergacon.effectText: Special: At the start of your turn, if you have two or more minions on a base, you may play this titan there. Ongoing: You have +3 power here. Talent: Move this titan to another base. It loses its ongoing ability until the end of the turn.

explorers_very_large_boulder.name: Very Large Boulder
explorers_very_large_boulder.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base that has no player's minions. Ongoing: Once per turn, after a minion moves from here, you may move this titan to the same base. Then destroy a minion at that base with less power than the number of +1 power counters on this titan. Ongoing: At the end of your turn, if this titan didn't move, place a +1 power counter on it.

fairies_spirit_of_the_forest.name: Spirit of the Forest
fairies_spirit_of_the_forest.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion and action play, you may play this titan. Ongoing: Once per turn, when you use an ability that says OR, you may use both parts in any order. Ongoing: If this titan would be removed when it loses a clash of titans, you may move it to another base instead.

ignobles_the_hill_that_strolls.name: The Hill that Strolls
ignobles_the_hill_that_strolls.effectText: Special: On your turn, you may play this titan if two or more minions you own are controlled by other players. Ongoing: After you give control of one of your minions to another player, you may place a +1 power counter on it. Talent: Give control of one of your minions to another player to draw a card, or take control of a minion here you own.

itty_critters_rainboroc.name: Rainboroc
itty_critters_rainboroc.effectText: Special: After you win a base while this titan is not in play, you may play it on the base that replaces it. Ongoing: After the first time each turn you play a minion of power 2 or less here, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Talent: Shuffle a minion of power 2 or less from your discard pile into your deck. If you do, you may move this titan to another base.

kaiju_gorgodzolla.name: Gorgodzolla
kaiju_gorgodzolla.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base where you have two or more actions. Ongoing: After you play an action or a minion on this base, place a +1 power counter on this titan. Ongoing: After you play an action on this base, you may draw a card.

magical_girls_walking_castle.name: Walking Castle
magical_girls_walking_castle.effectText: Special: Instead of your regular minion play, you may play this titan on a base where you have at least two minions.
